notes.body:
Metoprolol liver model
Metoprolol is a lipophilic, highly permeable drug (BCS class I). It equilibrates fast between the blood of the liver and the hepatocytes (METIM), its hepatic clearance is set by the enzymes. The metabolism has three routes [Article:2222517][Article:30087611]:
alpha-hydroxylation to alpha-hydroxymetoprolol (METOH), specific for CYP2D6; about 10 % of a dose are excreted as alpha-hydroxymetoprolol in the urine of extensive metabolizers, less than 1 % in poor metabolizers (Lennard1982, Kirchheiner2004).
O-demethylation and the oxidation to metoprolol acid by CYP2D6 (ODM2D6), the main route (60-65 % of a dose in the urine as metoprolol acid).
O-demethylation by other enzymes (CYP3A4, CYP2B6, CYP2C9; ODM), the clearance of poor metabolizers (Kirchheiner2004: the systemic clearance is 30.6 l/hr without an active CYP2D6 gene and increases by 20.9 l/hr per active gene).
The N-dealkylation (about 10 %) is part of the O-demethylation, its products are counted as metoprolol acid. The CYP2D6 reactions scale with the activity of the CYP2D6 diplotype (f_cyp2d6 = cyp2d6_activity/2, 1 for *1/*1), see the model of the CYP2D6 activity. The concentrations of the liver model are blood concentrations, the intrinsic clearances are clearances of blood.
[Ruedesheim2020] Km(met, → OH-M & ODM) = 10 [8.8-12.4] µM [Madani1999] Km(met → OH-M & ODM) = 26 +/- 9 µM (in liver) [Yang2019] Km(met, → OH-M & ODM) = 11.31 ± 1.21 µM [Kim1991] Km(met, → OH-M & ODM) = 20 [15.6-26.0] µM
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: The activity score of the CYP2D6 diplotype over the one of *1/*1 (2): 0 for poor metabolizers, 1.5 for *1x2/*1. The genotype is set by the alleles of the CYP2D6 model (cyp2d6_allele1, cyp2d6_allele2, the indexes of the alleles) or by an activity score (cyp2d6_ac with both allele indexes -1).

10-26 µM in human liver microsomes (Ruedesheim2020, Madani1999, Yang2019, Kim1991); the saturation of the first pass is the dose dependent bioavailability (31 % after 20 mg, 46 % after 100 mg metoprolol tartrate, Johnsson1975). Not fitted, the data do not identify it (a flat profile likelihood between 2 and 100 µM).
About 15 % of the hepatic metabolism of extensive metabolizers is alpha-hydroxylation (about 10 % of an oral dose in the urine as alpha-hydroxymetoprolol, Lennard1982, Kirchheiner2004).
The value of LI__METOH_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: Vmax of the O-demethylation by CYP2D6 (*1/*1)

body.p: Together with the alpha-hydroxylation an intrinsic blood clearance of about 1.7 l/min at *1/*1 (CYP2D6 adds 20.9 l/hr of plasma clearance per active gene, Kirchheiner2004), a hepatic extraction of about 0.57 and a bioavailability of about 0.43.
The value of LI__ODM2D6_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

parameter.name: Vmax of the O-demethylation by other enzymes than CYP2D6

body.p: An intrinsic blood clearance of about 0.25 l/min, the clearance of poor metabolizers without the renal clearance (30.6 l/hr of plasma, Kirchheiner2004).
The value of LI__ODM_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261017_183259__fc82a, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.
